The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-works-how-18|building]] on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

When comparing platforms for selling digital products, it's crucial to understand what each offers. Traditional platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy provide ease of use but are often restricted in certain countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH offers a comprehensive suite of tools for building and deploying online stores, including automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, without the limitations of geographical restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal have strict geographical restrictions, affecting creators in many countries. These restrictions can lead to account suspensions andheld funds, as seen with PayPal's policy of holding funds for up to 180 days without appeal. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to bypass these restrictions, providing creators with a reliable and consistent way to sell their digital products globally.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The speed and cost of transactions are critical factors for digital creators. Traditional platforms often charge high fees and may have slow payment processing times. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure utilizing cryptocurrencies can offer near-instant payment confirmations and significantly lower fees, such as the 0.5% fee offered by NOWPayments, making it a more appealing option for creators looking to maximize their earnings.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides full ownership and control over your digital storefront.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the level of ownership and control it provides to creators. With traditional platforms, creators are often at the mercy of the platform's terms and conditions. In contrast, sovereign infrastructure allows creators to own their store and customer data outright, automate payment and delivery processes, and ensure that their business can operate independently without the risk of sudden platform changes or restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries or those looking for more control over their digital storefronts, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear choice. It offers a robust, scalable, and secure solution that can be tailored to the creator's needs, providing a permanent alternative to traditional platforms. By choosing sovereign infrastructure, creators can ensure their business's longevity and success, free from the constraints of geographical and platform-based restrictions.
